name: The Piper Of Dawn
detailed_description:
Game Description

"Abandon all hope, ye who enter here" - Welcome to "Paradise"!

This farming-alchemy simulation weaves deep storytelling into gameplay as you embody an alchemist seeking fortune in a walled Diamond city. Begin your rise to fortune through alchemical mastery, herb cultivation, and workshop creation.

Rub shoulders with street dwellers, the Silver Key syndicate, and goddess worshipers. In Diamond City, your standing with its many mysterious factions determines how long you'll last. Build bonds with your chosen companion—be they divine, mystical, magical, or feline—and lose yourself in a fantasy where narrative depth meets the satisfaction of running your own thriving business.

Game Features

  • Land Development & Herb Farming

Grow extraordinary flora and enigmatic beings in your gardens! Carnivorous creatures sprouting from soil? Completely ordinary!

Each environment yields unique results - underground exploration reveals extraordinary secrets!

  • Grow Peoplesprout & Expand Your Workforce

The Peoplesprout Farm is here to ease your workload by quite literally growing your workforce. And we're giving every Peoplesprout a full life!

The value of labor lies in its plentiful harvest. The sweat you sow will bear the fruit of flesh. Whether it's a lone finger, a plump, juicy eyeball, or a fresh brain, each can sprout into a tireless employee, ready to work around the clock without the need for constant supervision.

Employees can also climb the full career ladder, from humble seedling to the prestigious title of Grand Sproutmaster.

  • Craft Workshop & Alchemy Setup

Forget the old ways. This is the age of mechanical alchemy.

Different machines produce different alchemical goods. Keep your workshop stocked through smart equipment management, and you'll outperform 99% of traditional, hand-crafting alchemists.

  • Commercial Ventures & Wealth Building

Design your marketplace layout, fulfill citizen commissions, systematically drain every customer's purse! As your reputation grows among mysterious local factions, otherworldly clients will patronize your establishment or discreetly commission high-value projects...

A feline cashier? Naturally... completely ordinary!

  • Narrative Immersion & Hidden Secrets

Truth reveals multiple faces across interconnected tales. Different factional alliances and romantic pursuits unlock unique story paths, culminating in diverse conclusive outcomes.

Companion Choice

  • Elisabeth Liebig & Helena Wolfen

Their shared reputation as "Twin Stars of the Sun Tavern" obscures individual identity, yet extended companionship reveals vastly different personalities and moral frameworks.

  • Goddess vs Witch

Sacred and forbidden powers demand exclusive loyalty - wielding both simultaneously remains impossible.

  • Gretel & Jimo Li

Solo alchemy lacks excitement - recruit this chaos catalyst! She guarantees perpetual peril!!

The alternative? Rather... useless...

  • Hypnos

A fragile soul dreaming beneath Death's shadow - disturbing her rest invites catastrophe...

  • ???

Perhaps a sentient wish-granter, cosmic horror vessel, or merely an innocent soul cloaked in mystery...

...

 

Paradise hosts diverse inhabitants. Through alliance or opposition, profound connections emerge, weaving destiny toward extraordinary conclusions.

Factional Politics

Criminal syndicates, neighborhood folks, goddess worshippers, "Mother's" disciples... Cultivating trust among different organizations reshapes Paradise's destiny while rewriting your personal fate.

Though bound by mortal limitations, harness alchemical prowess alongside humanity's distinctive persistence and valor to claim both personal fulfillment and this miniature realm's ultimate future.

short_description: Welcome to Diamond City—a sealed-off “Paradise”. You play the role of an alchemist running a one-stop empire: farming, "people farming," shopkeeping, and alchemy. Choose your companion and set out on a fantastical journey where rich storytelling blends seamlessly with deep simulation gameplay.
supported_languages: Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, Traditional Chinese
